title: 5 mm LED Assortment, 300 Pieces in 6 Colours with Storage Box
description:
Diffused 5 mm through-hole LEDs for breadboard projects, status indicators and repairs, sorted by colour in a compartment box.
• Contents: 300 LEDs, 50 each in red, green, blue, yellow, white and orange
• Forward voltage approx. 2.0–2.2 V (red, yellow, orange) and 3.0–3.2 V (green, blue, white) at 20 mA
• Longer leg marks the anode for easy polarity identification
• Use a series resistor when connecting to 5 V or higher

title: Electronic Components Starter Assortment, 1,000 Pieces in Labelled Box
description:
A well-stocked parts box for prototyping, repairs and learning electronics, with the most-used values sorted into labelled compartments.
• Resistors: 600 pieces in 30 values from 10 Ω to 1 MΩ, 1/4 W, 1% metal film
• Capacitors: 120 ceramic (10 pF–100 nF) and 60 electrolytic (1–470 µF)
• Semiconductors: 100 LEDs, 60 diodes and 60 NPN/PNP transistors
• Supplied in a clear storage box with a printed value chart

title: Trimmer Potentiometer Assortment, 130 Pieces in 13 Values, 100 Ω–1 MΩ
description:
Small adjustable resistors for setting voltages, display contrast, sensor thresholds and calibration points on circuit boards.
• Contents: 130 trimmers, 10 each of 13 values from 100 Ω to 1 MΩ
• Square top-adjust housing with 3 through-hole pins (2.5 mm pitch)
• Power rating 0.5 W; tolerance ±10%
• Supplied in a compartment box with value labels

title: Hook-Up Wire Kit 22 AWG, 6 Colours x 10 m, Solid Tinned Copper
description:
Solid-core wire that pushes neatly into breadboards and holds its shape, ideal for prototyping, wiring LEDs and small electronics.
• Contents: 6 spools x 10 m in black, red, yellow, green, blue and white
• 22 AWG (0.33 mm²) solid tinned copper with PVC insulation
• Rated 300 V and up to 80 °C
• Dispenser box lets wire pull out without tangling

title: Breadboard Starter Kit with 830-Point Board, Power Module and Jumper Wires
description:
Everything you need to start building and testing circuits without soldering, for beginners and quick prototypes alike.
• 830 tie-point solderless breadboard with adhesive back, approx. 16.5 x 5.5 cm
• Breadboard power module supplying 3.3 V and 5 V rails (USB or DC jack input)
• 65 flexible jumper wires in assorted lengths and colours
• Plus 40 male-to-female and 40 female-to-female jumper cables (20 cm)

title: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Development Board, Dual-Core 240 MHz, USB-C, 2-Pack
description:
Compact microcontroller boards with built-in wireless connectivity for smart-home sensors, connected gadgets and learning to code.
• Dual-core 32-bit processor up to 240 MHz with 520 KB SRAM and 4 MB flash
• 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n) and Bluetooth 4.2 / low energy
• USB-C port for power and programming; 3.3 V logic with 30 pins on headers
• Programmable with popular free, open-source development tools (no software included)

title: Adjustable DC-DC Step-Down Converter Module, 4.5–24 V In, 5 A, 2-Pack
description:
Turns a higher DC voltage into a stable, adjustable lower voltage for powering microcontrollers, LED strips, small motors and sensors.
• Input: 4.5–24 V DC; output: 0.8–20 V adjustable
• Up to 5 A output (add cooling above 3 A); efficiency up to 92%
• Screw terminals for input and output; multi-turn trimmer for setting the voltage
• Board size approx. 6 x 5 cm; pack of 2

title: Digital Multimeter with Large LCD, 1999 Counts and Protective Holster
description:
A full-function multimeter for home electrics, car batteries and electronics projects, with a big display and a rubber holster that absorbs knocks.
• Measures DC voltage up to 1000 V, AC voltage up to 750 V and current up to 20 A
• Also measures resistance, capacitance, diodes and transistor gain, with continuity buzzer
• Safety rating CAT II 600 V; fuse protection on the current ranges
• Included: silicone test leads, holster and 9 V battery

title: Digital Caliper 150 mm, Stainless Steel with mm/inch LCD Display
description:
Measure outside and inside diameters, depths and steps quickly and precisely, for workshop, 3D printing and model making.
• Range 0–150 mm, resolution 0.01 mm, accuracy ±0.03 mm
• Hardened stainless steel jaws with locking screw and depth rod
• mm/inch switch, zero at any position and automatic power-off
• Includes LR44 battery, a spare battery and a protective case

title: USB-C and USB-A Power Meter with Colour Display, 4–24 V, 0–3 A
description:
Plug it in between a charger and a device to see exactly how much voltage, current and power is flowing, for checking chargers, cables and power banks.
• Measures voltage (4–24 V), current (0–3 A), power, capacity (mAh) and energy (Wh)
• Detects common fast-charging protocols
• Colour display with selectable orientation
• USB-C and USB-A input and output ports; powered by the connection, no battery needed

title: Soldering Iron Kit 60 W with Adjustable Temperature 200–450 °C, EU Plug
description:
A complete starter soldering set for electronics repairs, DIY kits and hobby projects, packed in a carry case.
• 60 W iron with temperature dial (200–450 °C); EU plug and 1.5 m cable
• Ceramic heating element heats up in about 30–60 seconds
• Included: 5 interchangeable tips, stand with cleaning sponge, 0.8 mm lead-free solder wire, desoldering pump and tweezers
• Use in a ventilated area and always return the iron to its stand

title: Soldering Practice Kit with PCB Board and Through-Hole Components
description:
Learn to solder, or warm up your technique before a real project, on a practice board designed for repetition.
• Practice PCB with surface-mount pads and through-hole positions in several sizes
• Includes matching parts: resistors, LEDs, ceramic capacitors and pin headers
• Step-by-step guide covering technique and how to inspect a good joint
• Soldering iron and solder not included; ages 14+ with adult supervision

title: Precision Screwdriver Set, 25 Bits with Magnetic Holder for Electronics Repair
description:
A compact repair kit for opening phones, laptops, controllers, glasses and small appliances without damaging tiny screws.
• 25 S2 steel bits: cross PH000–PH2, slotted 1.5–4 mm, star T3–T20, hex 1.5–4 mm, pentalobe and tri-wing
• Aluminium handle with swivel top and magnetic bit holder
• Bits stored in a hinged case with labelled slots
• Includes a flexible extension shaft

title: Anti-Static Precision Tweezers Set, 6 Pieces, ESD-Safe Stainless Steel
description:
Fine tweezers for placing and holding small parts during soldering, electronics repair, model making and crafts.
• 6 tweezers with straight, curved, fine-point, flat, rounded and angled tips
• Non-magnetic stainless steel with ESD-safe coating
• Length approx. 11.5–14 cm
• Stored in a zipped protective pouch

title: Electrical Insulating Tape, 10 Rolls 19 mm x 20 m, Flame-Retardant PVC
description:
Stretchy PVC tape for insulating and bundling wires, colour-coding cables and quick repairs around the home and workshop.
• 10 rolls x 20 m, 19 mm wide, 0.13 mm thick
• Flame-retardant PVC rated to 600 V and up to 80 °C
• Stretches and conforms tightly around joints and connectors
• Choose all black or 10 assorted colours

title: Nuts, Bolts and Washers Assortment, 600 Pieces M3–M8 in Storage Case
description:
A workshop assortment of the most common metric fasteners, so you always have the right size to hand for repairs and builds.
• 600 pieces: hex bolts, hex nuts, flat washers and spring washers
• Sizes M3, M4, M5, M6 and M8; bolt lengths 10–40 mm
• Zinc-plated carbon steel for corrosion resistance
• Sorted in a 24-compartment case with a labelled lid

title: Small Parts Storage Cabinet with 24 Clear Drawers, Wall-Mountable
description:
Keep screws, electronic components, fuses and fittings sorted and visible in a compact drawer cabinet for the workshop or hobby room.
• 24 transparent drawers, each approx. 13 x 6.5 x 4 cm, with label holders
• Sturdy polypropylene frame; stands on a bench or hangs on the wall (screws and plugs included)
• Drawer stops prevent drawers falling out when opened
• Overall size approx. 38 x 15 x 31 cm; cabinets can be stacked

title: Clear Packing Tape, 6 Rolls 48 mm x 66 m with Handheld Dispenser
description:
Strong, clear tape for sealing parcels, moving boxes and storage cartons, with a dispenser that makes taping fast and neat.
• 6 rolls x 66 m, 48 mm wide, 45 µm thick
• Acrylic adhesive that holds on cardboard in warm and cold conditions
• Handheld dispenser with serrated blade and blade guard
• Low-noise unwind

title: Bubble Wrap Roll 50 cm x 10 m with 10 mm Bubbles, Perforated
description:
Cushioning wrap that protects glassware, electronics and other fragile items when moving house or shipping parcels.
• Roll size: 50 cm x 10 m with 10 mm air bubbles
• Perforated every 30 cm for easy tearing without scissors
• Lightweight LDPE film keeps parcel weight low
• Recyclable where facilities exist

title: Cardboard Shipping Boxes, Pack of 25, 30 x 20 x 15 cm Single Wall
description:
Sturdy brown postal boxes for sending parcels, storing items or moving, delivered flat to save space until you need them.
• 25 boxes, internal size 30 x 20 x 15 cm
• Single-wall corrugated cardboard (B flute) in brown kraft
• Fold and tape to assemble; flaps close flush
• Made with recycled fibre and fully recyclable
